$sources: AS/NZS 1170.0:2002 Tables 3.1-3.3 and the NCC (BCA) Table B1.2a-b (importance levels and annual probabilities of exceedance, design working life 50 years)
source: Importance levels IL1-IL4 in SAEngine's category slots I-IV: the seismic importance is the probability factor kp of the level's annual probability (AS 1170.4 Table 3.1); the wind importance is the level's marker that picks its row of wind.speedFactors.riskCoefficients (VR / V500 of the annual probability).

I.description: Importance level 1: low consequence for human life (farm buildings, isolated minor structures); wind 1/100, earthquake 1/250

II.description: Importance level 2: normal structures (houses, offices, apartments); wind and earthquake 1/500

III.description: Importance level 3: large numbers of people or high consequence (crowds over 300, schools, major hospitals not post-disaster); wind and earthquake 1/1000

IV.description: Importance level 4: post-disaster functions (hospitals with surgery, emergency services); wind 1/2500, earthquake 1/1500

sources.categories.I: AS/NZS 1170.0 Table 3.2 IL1; NCC Table B1.2b: wind 1/100, earthquake 1/250; AS 1170.4 Table 3.1 kp(1/250) = 0.75
sources.categories.IV: AS/NZS 1170.0 Table 3.2 IL4; NCC Table B1.2b: wind 1/2500, earthquake 1/1500; kp(1/1500) = 1.5
